_readme: VB-MAPP protocol content for the ROH ERP app. VB-MAPP (Sundberg, AVB Press) is copyrighted: the app ships only category names and placeholders. The centre fills this file in from its LICENSED manual.

Any string that is empty or contains 'enter from licensed protocol' is treated as NOT filled in: the app shows a placeholder label instead. Numbers left as null are also treated as not filled in; where a number is needed (bands, mapping) the app then falls back to manual entry.

Entries without the placeholder marker that already existed in app v1 (barrier 1 criteria, transition areas 1-7 criteria, EESA group 1-2 words and the group 1 heading) were carried over unchanged. Verify them against the licensed manual and replace as needed.
barriers.<key>: <key> is the stored barrier_scores key; never rename it. 'label' is the display name; 'criteria' '0'..'4' is the scoring guidance shown next to each score.
transition.areas.<1..18>: 'criteria' '1'..'5' is the scoring guidance. Areas 1-7 learner skills, 8-13 learning patterns, 14-18 self-help/spontaneity.

transition.milestones_score_bands / barriers_score_bands: one row per transition score 1..5 with the inclusive min/max Milestones total (0-170) or Barriers total (0-96) that earns it. When all five rows of a table have numbers, transition area 1 (or 2) is computed automatically from the saved Milestones (or Barriers) total of the same test number.

eesa.groups[]: 'items' is the item text in administration order; a group's item count is the length of its array. The default 25/25/20/15/15 = 100 split is a placeholder layout: adjust it to the manual BEFORE scores are saved, because saved responses are keyed by group and item position.

eesa.echoic_milestone_mapping: rows {min_total, echoic_score}. The Echoic milestone score for a test is the echoic_score of the row with the highest min_total that is <= the EESA total (0-100). echoic_score must be 0-10 in steps of 0.5. When every row has numbers, the Milestones page shows Echoic as read-only 'from EESA'. Remove unused rows rather than leaving them null.
eesa.legacy_v1_words: only used to read EESA records saved by app v1 (keyed by word). Do not edit.

criteria.0: Does not demonstrate any significant negative behaviors
criteria.1: Engages in some minor negative behaviors weekly, but recovery is quick
criteria.2: Emits a variety of minor negative behaviors daily (e.g., crying, verbal refusal)
criteria.3: Emits more severe negative behavior daily (e.g., tantrums, throwing things)
criteria.4: Often emits severe negative behavior that is a danger to himself or others

criteria.1: Severe behavior problems, requires 1:1 supervision at all times

criteria.1: Does not participate in any group activities or follow routines

criteria.3: Follows 3-4 daily routines with gestural or verbal prompts
criteria.4: Participates in small groups (2-3 peers) for 10 minutes with minimal prompts

criteria.1: Does not interact with peers, engages only in solitary or self-stimulatory play
criteria.2: Parallel play near peers without disruption for 5 minutes
criteria.3: Initiates 2-3 interactions or shares items with peers with prompts

criteria.1: Cannot work independently for any duration on structured tasks

criteria.4: Works independently for 5 minutes completing a work-task bin system
criteria.5: Works independently for 15 minutes completing new instructional tasks

criteria.1: Skills do not generalize beyond specific therapist and training setting
criteria.2: Generalizes to 1 other person or setting with high reinforcement
criteria.3: Generalizes skills to 2-3 novel persons and novel stimulus materials
criteria.4: Consistently generalizes across multiple settings, instructors, and materials
criteria.5: Rapidly generalizes newly acquired skills across natural environmental contexts
